/.title: Bible Presenter — Georgian, English and Russian verses on the projector
/.shareTitle: Bible Presenter — verses on the projector, in three languages at once
/.description: Put a Bible verse on the projector in Georgian, English and Russian at once. Pick book, chapter and verse on one screen, press Show, and the second screen follows — plus lyrics, a stream lower third, and 20 backgrounds. Free, no sign-up.

/studio.title: Studio — one console for the whole service | Bible Presenter
/studio.shareTitle: Bible Presenter Studio — one console for the whole service
/studio.description: Passages, song lyrics and the playlist in one window, sent to the projector and to the OBS stream at the same time. Search the library with ⌘F, build a playlist, and drive a broadcast lower third.
/studio.imageAlt: The Bible Presenter studio console: Bible, Lyrics, Playlist and OBS lower third, beside a screen carrying a Georgian verse

/bible.title: Read a chapter — Bible Presenter
/bible.description: Read a whole chapter in Georgian, English or Russian, in any of the translations the projector can show.

/doc.title: How to run a service with it — Bible Presenter
/doc.description: Setting up the operator window and the projector window, choosing translations, and what the green and blue checkboxes do. In Georgian and English.

/donation.title: Support the project — Bible Presenter
/donation.description: Bible Presenter is free. If it helps your church, here is how to help keep it running.

/show.title: Projector — Bible Presenter
/show.description: The projector output. It shows whatever the operator window last sent, and is meant for a second screen.

/lower3rd.title: Lower third — Bible Presenter
/lower3rd.description: The OBS browser source. It draws the live slide as a broadcast lower third over a transparent background.
